* Profit for the period/ year, total other comprehensive income/(loss) and total comprehensive income/(loss) for the period/ year are entirely attributable to the owners of FIL.

Notes:

1. The consolidated financial results of Finolex Industries Limited ('FIL') and its two associates for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on October 30, 2026 and a limited review of the same has been carried out by the statutory auditor of FIL.

2. These results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the Indian Accounting Standard ('Ind AS') 34, 'Interim Financial Reporting' prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and is in compliance with the presentation and disclosure requirements of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended).

3. FIL has a single operating segment comprising the manufacturing and sale of pipes and fittings. Accordingly, no separate segment disclosures are required under Ind AS 108.

4. Previous year/periods figures have been rearranged/ re-grouped, wherever considered necessary, to make them comparable with those of the current year/ period.
